description: Identify accounts depositing at or near the same amount.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop-smurfing | WHERE account.event == "deposit" AND event.amount > 0 AND atm.deposit_type == "cash" | EVAL amount_bucket = ROUND(event.amount / 50) * 50 | STATS account_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(account.name), total_deposits = COUNT(), avg_amount = AVG(event.amount), std_dev = STD_DEV(event.amount), min_account = MIN(account.name), max_account = MAX(account.name) BY amount_bucket | WHERE account_count >= 3 AND std_dev < 25 | EVAL deposits_per_account = total_deposits / account_count, suspicion_score = account_count * deposits_per_account / (std_dev + 1) | SORT suspicion_score DESC | LIMIT 10
